$comment: TTS voices for demo videos: Fish Audio direct (engine fish) or through OpenRouter (engine openrouter, e.g. fish-audio/drama-3, always paid: renders need --allow-paid-tts and OPENROUTER_API_KEY; requests carry the DomDimaBot app-attribution headers). Every voice needs its owner/source and a license that allows use in ads. Fish terms: free-plan / s2.1-pro-free audio is for personal or test use; published ads need paid usage (fish.audio/terms). All voices below are Fish Official designed voices (source voice_design), not clones of real people. Drama 3 takes free-form [bracket] directions anywhere in a line, e.g. [excited, a little out of breath], [laughs].
